key.name: keep-ready
key.summary: Apps kept ready in memory (Settings: "Always keep ready")
key.description: In the background these apps are suspended (no CPU) instead of running, and they are closed last when memory runs low.

key.name: prelaunch
key.summary: Apps started hidden at login
key.description: Started in the background without a window on screen, then kept ready (suspended).

key.name: preload
key.summary: Apps whose files are preloaded into the page cache

key.name: freeze-background
key.summary: Suspend every app in the background
key.description: Off: only kept-ready apps are suspended; other background apps keep running (music, downloads, terminal jobs). Apps in com.canonical.qtmir lifecycle-exempt-appids are never suspended.

key.name: saver-freeze
key.summary: Battery saver is active: suspend every background app (set by fp6-app-ready)
key.description: Mirrors /run/fp6-battery/saver. Lomiri treats it like freeze-background.

key.name: preload-budget-mb
key.summary: Preload budget per app (MiB of files)

key.name: preload-interval-min
key.summary: Minutes between preload refreshes (0 = at login only)

key.name: mlock-mb
key.summary: MiB of the preloaded files locked in RAM (0 = none)

key.name: zram-enabled
key.summary: Compressed swap in RAM (zram)

key.name: low-memory-killer
key.summary: Close background apps when memory runs low
key.description: Other background apps first, kept-ready apps last; never the app on screen or the shell.

key.name: profile
key.summary: Memory profile
key.description: conservative: few apps kept, little cache warming, early closing. balanced. aggressive: free RAM is used to keep the likely next apps ready and their files cached; apps are still closed (least likely first) before memory runs out.

key.name: prediction
key.summary: Learn which apps are used when, and keep the likely next ones ready
key.description: Learned on the device only (hour, weekday/weekend, charging, Wi-Fi connected, headphones as yes/no; which app follows which). No network names or locations.

key.name: ready-apps
key.summary: Predicted apps kept ready (-1 = the profile's number)

key.name: preload-at-boot
key.summary: Warm the shell's and the likely apps' files after login

key.name: zram-percent
key.summary: Compressed memory size in % of RAM (25, 50, 75, 100; 0 = the profile's size)

key.name: never-keep
key.summary: Apps never kept ready
key.description: Not kept ready, started or warmed by prediction; closed first when memory runs low.

key.name: predicted
key.summary: Predicted apps kept ready now (written by fp6-app-ready, read by Lomiri)

key.name: clear-history-request
key.summary: Changed by the Settings page to clear the learned usage history

key.name: installed-apps
key.summary: Apps the Settings page offers ("id TAB name TAB icon"), kept by fp6-app-ready

key.name: app-list-request
key.summary: Changed by the Settings page to ask fp6-app-ready to rescan the apps

key.name: status-file
key.summary: Path of the status JSON the daemon writes (for the Settings page)
